name: asset-classes
comment: Classification maps for SPEC §6.1 consolidation and §6.4 exposure. Instrument types map to a broad asset class and a liquidity tier; keys match the ledger schema's instrumentType enum exactly.

liquidity_tier_by_type.comment: t0 = same day, t1 = next day, t2_5 = 2-5 days, illiquid = no reliable market

wrapped_by_wrapper.comment: SPEC §6.4 unwrapped-vs-wrapped ratio, per jurisdiction. 'wrapped' means the wrapper confers a tax shelter in its own jurisdiction.

single_issuer_flag_threshold.source: SPEC §6.4: single-issuer positions above 5% of investable wealth are flagged
